query: Fix jnp.take_along_axis dimension mismatch error in fermion-spinless-backflow
answer: The error occurs because the indices and array must have the same number of dimensions in jnp.take_along_axis. To fix it, ensure the dimensions match by properly reshaping or expanding dimensions of the indices array before passing it to jnp.take_along_axis. The indices array should have the same number of dimensions as the target array.

query: Proper indexing of occupied orbitals in neural backflow model
answer: To properly index occupied orbitals, first find the positions of occupied orbitals using n.nonzero(size=self.hilbert.n_fermions)[0], then use these indices to extract the corresponding rows from the orbital matrix M[R]. query: Handle batched inputs in LogNeuralBackflow model for fermions
answer: To handle batched inputs, use jnp.vectorize with signature='(n)->()' to operate on single configurations, or ensure proper broadcasting when applying operations across batch dimensions. The model should accept inputs of shape (batch_size, N) and maintain correct dimensionality throughout computations.

query: Correct use of jnp.nonzero with keepdims in backflow model
answer: When using jnp.nonzero, set size=self.hilbert.n_fermions to ensure consistent output size, and use [0] to extract the indices array. The keepdims parameter is not applicable to jnp.nonzero - instead, use array reshaping operations to control dimensions after obtaining the indices.
